source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As your turn begins, if you have fulfilled your current Oath, set up an extra Oath as [Code Chivalric](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.code-chivalric) describes, except:

- you cannot pick any Deed or Quality picked before; if a random roll gives you one of those, pick one you have not picked instead
- once you have picked every Deed and every Quality, you set up no more extra Oaths

Qualities of the Oaths you have fulfilled keep applying to every model of yours with [Code Chivalric](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.code-chivalric). Completing the Deed of an extra Oath gives you 1CP instead, however you picked its Deed or Quality.
